The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

About SANOVIO

SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily.

Our software, SANOVIO aOS, uses AI agents to take over the tedious work: cleaning up product data, comparing requests and offers, bundling demand and keeping orders on track. It connects to the systems our customers already use.

When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers. You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems, untangle their data and processes, and ship the solutions that make them successful.

This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics, or bring experience in technical product management, product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense: what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees.

Tasks

  • Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers

  • Owning customer implementations end to end, from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement

  • Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential

  • Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems

  • Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) and building robust data pipelines and mappings

  • Configuring and extending our AI agents for customer-specific workflows such as data matching and order automation

  • Prototyping and shipping customer-facing workflows, tools and dashboards with a strong focus on usability for non-technical users

  • Bringing customer insights back into the product and turning recurring solutions into product features together with our engineering team and the founders

Communication and customer focus

  • You enjoy talking to customers: you listen carefully, ask the right questions and explain technical topics in plain language

  • Native-level German and very good English, so you can confidently lead conversations and workshops with our customers

  • Confident with all kinds of stakeholders, from procurement managers to IT departments

  • Willing to work on-site in Munich and to travel regularly to customers in Germany and Switzerland

General Profile

  • Degree in Business Informatics (Wirtschaftsinformatik), Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field. Skills matter more to us than your degree, so equivalent hands-on experience counts just as much

  • Strong process understanding: you enjoy mapping, analyzing and improving business processes such as procure-to-pay or supply chain

  • High ownership, structured problem-solving and the drive to deliver fast in ambiguous environments

  • This is a junior role: a great fit if you're a recent graduate or have up to five years of professional experience. Internships and working student jobs count too

Technical skillset

  • First hands-on experience with system integrations and interfaces (e.g. REST APIs, webhooks, EDI or file-based interfaces), whether from work, internships or university projects

  • Solid coding skills (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python) and good SQL and data skills

  • Product and design affinity: you care about UX and can turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces. Experience with Figma or building UIs is a plus

Bonus if you

  • Worked at a startup or software company focused on SAP/ERP, integration platforms, process mining or procurement software (internships and working student jobs count too)

  • Have first experience as a Technical PM, Product Engineer, Solutions or Implementation Engineer, or ERP consultant

  • Have built with LLMs or AI agents, e.g. for data extraction or matching

  • Bring domain knowledge in healthcare, hospitals, procurement or supply chain

  • Can share a portfolio, GitHub or case studies of projects you shipped

Benefits

  • A steep learning curve: you learn integration work, process consulting and product building at the same time, working closely with the founders

  • Real ownership and direct impact on how we work with our customers

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly wellness budget

  • Access to the AI and productivity tools you need

  • Regular customer visits across Germany and Switzerland

  • Compensation package including cash, performance bonus and shares

About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro call to get to know each other, introduce SANOVIO and talk about your experience.

Step 2: Case study

A practical case based on a real-world challenge from our platform, for example how you would connect a hospital or a supplier to SANOVIO and redesign its ordering process. You'll present your approach to the team, just like you would to a customer.

Step 3: Personal fit

Meet one of our co-founders to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & reference checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. We'll also ask for two to three references.

About

Fabriq est la solution innovante de pilotage d'atelier qui améliore la productivité des équipes de production. Fabriq rassemble et digitalise tous les outils de votre système d'excellence opérationnelle (AIC, plans d'actions, tour de terrain et audits, résolution de problèmes, management visuel et KPI).

Nous sommes rentables depuis 2024, avons levé 26M€ au total (dont 22M€ en juin 2025 auprès d'Expedition Capital), et équipons plus de 700 sites dans 43 pays pour des clients comme Danone, LVMH et Scania. L'équipe compte 110 collaborateurs.

Grâce à Fabriq, les équipes de production peuvent gagner en efficacité, résoudre les problèmes deux fois plus vite et améliorer l'efficience de 2 à 5% en capitalisant sur les données terrain.

Job Description

  • The company, its business and its ambition

The ambition. Fabriq is bringing European industry into the 21st century: making factories more competitive and frontline teams more autonomous. This is not only a software play, it is the industrial relocalisation project.

The business. Fabriq is the SaaS platform that replaces the whiteboards and Excel spreadsheets still running 80% of industrial sites. Operators, team leads and plant managers track real-time KPIs (safety, quality, lead time, productivity), surface and solve shop-floor problems, run their daily routines and collaborate across teams in one place. The long-term ambition is to become the Operating System of every production floor.

The proof.

  • 700+ industrial sites equipped across 43+ countries.
  • Reference customers such as Safran, Airbus, Renault, Scania, LVMH, Andros, Bel, Merck and Lonza.
  • Profitable since late 2024, then €22M raised in June 2025 with Expedition Capital to accelerate in the US, the UK and DACH.
  • A team of ~130 people, and an AI roadmap that is already in customers' hands rather than on a slide.
  • The role

Context : You join the AI team, a two-person unit led by Jean (Product Lead) alongside Halim, Senior Engineer who has built much of the Fabriq product. This team operates as a prototyping squad at the front edge of the company: it tests new ideas, measures market appetite and decides whether Fabriq goes there. Products are in alpha, cycles are short, the roadmap is directional. The team also works weekly with Octave, co-founder, which gives you direct exposure to the strategic decisions.

Objective : Become Halim's pair and second engineer on AI, reach full autonomy on the stack and the customer context within 6 months, and take Fabriq's AI products from alpha to something industrial teams rely on every day.

Challenges

  • Taking AI prototypes to production quality. Conversational and voice-driven agents, plugged into real industrial data and used by real teams on the floor. You take them from alpha to something people rely on daily: answer quality, reliability, and the cost per interaction that decides whether a use case scales or gets dropped.
  • Prototyping to convince. Part of the roadmap is co-built with partner customers, which means it is sold before it is built. Specs move as customers shape them, timelines are tight, and you build fast to prove a use case is worth pursuing. Testing a lot and abandoning a lot is part of the deal.
  • Agentic engineering from scratch. No Mastra, no LangGraph, no off-the-shelf framework. Everything is hand-built in TypeScript and Deno on top of frontier models called through AWS Bedrock. When the team needs something like agent memory compaction, you design it yourself. This is genuinely custom, sparsely documented territory, and that is precisely the technical interest of the role.
  • Setting the technical direction with Halim. You are the second engineer, not an extra pair of hands: code reviews, architecture debates, and the freedom to arrive with your own proposals rather than waiting for a ticket.

Your first 3 months are dedicated to ramping up on the Fabriq stack and product, contributing to the AI features already in the hands of beta customers, and shipping your first POCs.

  • Software engineering depth: 4 to 5 years minimum. Real craftsmanship, clean design decisions, and the ability to explain the architecture trade-offs you made and why.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You move forward, decide and ship when nothing is specified in advance, and you adapt when the roadmap shifts.

  • A first hands-on experience with agentic systems. Expertise is welcome when it is real : a strong engineer with genuine curiosity and early agentic work beats a self-declared two-year agentic expert who cannot explain concretely what they built.
  • A data background. The testing logic differs from pure software: working on datasets and analysing where a system succeeds and where it fails is a plus, and it can be learned here.

Backend: TypeScript on Deno. Frontend: Vue.js. Infrastructure: AWS with EKS, Terraform and CDKTF, plus Kubernetes for on-prem customer deployments. Observability: Honeycomb and Sentry. Pionnier de la Bank-As-A-Service, Okali, accompagne les entreprises et les fintechs dans la conception, le développement et le pilotage de solutions de paiement innovantes. Nous avons notamment contribué à la naissance et au développement d’entreprises à succès telles que Lydia, Spendesk, Blank ou encore Limonetik.

Le poste en quelques mots

Okali est un acteur bancaire dont le métier est avant tout opérationnel : exécuter des paiements, entrer en relation avec les clients, gérer le cycle de vie des comptes et assurer la conformité de chaque opération. Une erreur sur ces parcours touche directement l'argent et les données de nos clients. Vous êtes le garant de la qualité de bout en bout : vous vérifiez que les parcours métier (virements SEPA entrants et sortants, prélèvements, opérations par carte, ouverture de compte, rappels de virement, saisies) se comportent de la même manière sur tous les environnements, du développement à la préproduction.

En tant que Senior QA Engineer, vous concevez et maintenez la suite de tests qui couvre ces parcours, en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs, les équipes produit et les opérations. Vous ne vous contentez pas d'exécuter des scénarios : vous décidez de ce qui doit être testé, à quel niveau et à quelle fréquence, et vous êtes le premier interlocuteur lorsqu'un scénario échoue en préproduction. Vous êtes aussi un point d'appui pour l'équipe : vous défendez une vision exigeante de la qualité, sans en faire un frein à la livraison.

Vos missions

  • Concevoir et maintenir la suite de tests de bout en bout rédigée en Gherkin, avec des scénarios lisibles par les équipes métier.
  • Définir la priorisation des scénarios (smoke, criticité p0, p1, p2) et veiller à leur exécution quotidienne en préproduction.
  • Analyser les échecs pour distinguer un défaut produit d'une instabilité de test, et supprimer les tests non fiables.
  • Concevoir des jeux de données de test déterministes (comptes, IBAN, cartes, transactions) et les rendre réutilisables.
  • Tester les API signées, les messages ISO 20022 et les traitements asynchrones, en vérifiant les effets réels sur les comptes et les soldes.
  • Étendre la couverture aux actions du Back Office, dans un navigateur, pour sécuriser les parcours utilisés par les équipes opérations et conformité.
  • Contribuer aux tests de charge pour garantir les performances des traitements de paiement.
  • Participer aux revues de spécifications dès la conception, et aux analyses d'incidents.
  • Rédiger des tickets Jira explicites et découpés en sous-tâches qui permettent à un développeur de reproduire un défaut sans poser de question.

Notre stack technique

Notre suite de tests de bout en bout est écrite en TypeScript, avec Cucumber pour les scénarios Gherkin, et s'appuie sur le client de requêtes HTTP de Playwright. Elle signe les requêtes en RSA SHA-256 conformément aux exigences de nos API et s'exécute sur les environnements dev, integration et preprod. Les rapports HTML et JSON sont générés à chaque exécution, les journaux d'audit sont archivés, et les campagnes sont planifiées chaque matin (smoke) et chaque soir (p0) via GitHub Actions. Les tests unitaires et d'intégration reposent sur Jest, avec PostgreSQL et LocalStack pour simuler les services AWS. Les tests de charge sont écrits avec k6. L'ensemble du code tourne sur Node.js et Bun.

Vous n'êtes pas attendu sur l'ensemble de cette stack dès le premier jour. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable d'apprendre vite, de remettre en question nos pratiques quand c'est pertinent et d'en proposer de meilleures.

Votre profil

Nous valorisons au même niveau vos compétences techniques et vos qualités humaines. Un profil senior, pour nous, sait faire et sait faire ensemble.

Sur le plan technique, vous maîtrisez l'automatisation de tests en TypeScript et savez écrire des scénarios Gherkin qui restent lisibles pour un responsable opérationnel. Vous avez une pratique des tests d'API, idéalement REST et GraphQL, et vous savez interroger une base PostgreSQL pour vérifier l'état réel d'un compte ou d'une transaction. Vous comprenez les mécanismes de signature de requêtes et les formats de messages financiers (ISO 20022, SEPA, EBICS), ou vous vous y formez rapidement. Vous savez tester des flux asynchrones, écrire des tests de charge et intégrer vos tests dans une chaîne d'intégration continue. Une expérience de Jira est attendue : vous rédigez des tickets explicites, avec un objectif, un périmètre, des critères d'acceptation et des sous-tâches (reproduction, correctif, vérification), et vous savez distinguer un défaut d'une instabilité de test. Dans un métier aussi régulé que la banque, la trace de chaque anomalie et de sa résolution fait partie du travail, au même titre que le test lui-même.

Vous utilisez l'IA générative au quotidien, avec discernement : pour générer des jeux de données, explorer des cas limites ou rédiger des scénarios, en relisant systématiquement ce qu'elle produit et en ne lui confiant jamais de données clients. Savoir expliquer comment et pourquoi vous l'employez compte autant, pour nous, que le résultat obtenu.

Sur le plan humain, vous avez un esprit critique et une rigueur qui inspirent confiance sans créer de tension. Vous savez expliquer un défaut à un développeur de façon factuelle, et un risque métier à un responsable opérationnel en termes simples. Vous êtes méthodique dans la préparation de vos campagnes de tests, autonome sur la priorisation, et vous assumez vos choix de couverture, y compris lorsqu'ils sont contestés. Vous aimez transmettre : la qualité se construit collectivement, et vous aidez les développeurs à écrire des tests qui leur servent réellement.

Environnement de travail

  • Nous veillons à un rythme soutenable et à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.
  • Des parcours d'évolution sont possibles, vers un rôle de référent qualité ou de lead QA.

Notre engagement

Okali recrute sur les compétences et le potentiel. Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, y compris celles dont le parcours ne suit pas le schéma classique. Si certains points de cette fiche vous semblent hors de portée, postulez quand même : nous évaluons ce que vous savez faire et ce que vous souhaitez apprendre.

We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Platform Engineering

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.


Your Skills & Experience:

Please indicate your years of experience on the application form.

  • 7+ years of professional experience building SaaS products or data-heavy platforms.

  • High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…).

  • Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data.

  • A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization.

  • Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus.

  • Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl, or similar) is a big plus.

  • Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus.

  • Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

  • Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

AI as a multiplier

AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships.

The bar

We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership from day one, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow.

You don’t need to speak French to apply (and you don’t need perfect English; we’ll help you ramp up quickly).

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

Relocation

  • We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

  • Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home.

  • Help with french paperwork like opening a french social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare) and more.

  • French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life.

Concevoir et développer le back-end

- Vous concevez et développez des API REST et GraphQL performantes et hautement scalables en Node.js (TypeScript / Express / NestJS) pour supporter les fortes montées de charge.

Déployer et faire progresser

- Vous déployez et gérez les microservices dans un environnement Cloud (AWS / GCP / Kubernetes) via une chaîne CI/CD automatisée (GitLab CI / GitHub Actions).

- Expérience des architectures microservices, de la gestion du cache (Redis) et des flux événementiels.
- Pratique poussée du TDD et d'une stratégie de test complète.
- Sensibilité aux problématiques Cloud / DevOps (Docker, CI/CD) et d'optimisation de performances.
- Pratique des méthodes Agiles (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).

Rémunération : Selon profil et expérience.

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and occasional travel between the two. We offer a competitive package.

Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Für Design ist das ein seltener Ausgangspunkt: Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Für diese Berufe hat noch nie jemand ernsthaft gestaltet. Du wärst die erste Design-Person in unserem neuen Produktteam und baust Design-System und Designprozess mit auf.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Wir arbeiten als ein Team von Product Engineers, manche technischer, manche gestalterischer. Du wärst die gestalterischste Person, arbeitest aber im selben Repository und Rhythmus wie alle anderen. Was du gestaltest, ist meist wenige Wochen später live.
  • Du verantwortest den Designprozess von Anfang bis Ende: Du führst Interviews mit Verwaltern und Eigentümern, verdichtest die Erkenntnisse zu Konzepten und gestaltest daraus Interfaces für Kundenportal und Verwaltercockpit. Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg.
  • Deine Designs bleiben nicht in Figma: Mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) bringst du sie selbst ins Frontend und setzt Teil-Features, teils auch ganze Features, gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Produkt landet, und legst dafür selbst Hand an.
  • Ein besonderes Feld ist Design für KI-Agenten: Du gestaltest Interaktionsmuster für Workflows, in denen Agenten Aufgaben übernehmen. Wo braucht der Nutzer Kontrolle, wo Transparenz? Muster, für die es noch kaum Vorbilder gibt.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign, gern mit B2B-Software oder komplexen Workflows.
  • Ein Portfolio mit 2 bis 3 Case Studies, die deinen Weg von der Nutzerfrage bis zum ausgelieferten Interface zeigen: Deine Denkweise interessiert uns mehr als die Menge an Screens.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, von Wireframes über klickbare Prototypen bis zur Komponentenbibliothek.
  • Erfahrung mit qualitativem Research: Interviews führen, Erkenntnisse verdichten, Annahmen mit Usability-Tests prüfen.
  • Gespür für Interaction Design und Informationsarchitektur in datenreichen Anwendungen.
  • Gute bis sehr gute Praxis mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, v0): Du bringst Teil-Features oder ganze Features selbst in den Code.
  • Solide Grundlagen in HTML und CSS, JavaScript ist ein Plus.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du gestaltest, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
  • Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, Richtung UX Engineering oder Produktverantwortung, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich.
  • Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
  • Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
  • Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.
